main_body: Large round leaf canopy (rows ~1-31) on a short trunk (rows 32-42) with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Light-to-mid green leaf mass at rows ~2-14 forms the upper canopy surface, with a dark green shadow band at rows ~15-18, then the lower canopy volume. It is organic foliage with no hard horizontal surface.
evidence: The canopy is a rounded volume lit from above: the upper leaf mass is lighter, a dark shadow band sits at rows ~15-18 where the upper clump overhangs the lower one, and the lower canopy with its bright highlights spreads over the trunk. The trunk and grass base sit below it. There is no flat front elevation and no receding side face. An organic tree reads as a 3/4 volume with its top lit and its underside shaded, so it passes.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 greens, from deep dark green through mid greens to a light highlight, with a dark green outline tinted by the leaves rather than neutral black. The clumps are blocky and the texture is pixel mottling, not the individual leaf clusters and per-leaf highlights of the references. The trunk is a narrow, mostly flat brown with only 3-4 tones and little bark texture, and the grass patch at the base is nearly flat. Overall it is a clean piece but a bit softer, blurrier and thinner than the Beodeul references, which have crisper leaf clumps and visible branches and roots.
